pr_body:
Fixes #1047
This PR adds support for bitlocker drives.
When the user clicks on a drive on the sidebar, this PR:
- checks is the drive is bitlocker-encrypted and locked
- displays a dialog to ask for password
- attempts to unlock the drive

Some testing on a pc different from mine is probably in order 😄

issue_context.title: Ask for password when opening bit locked drive for the first time
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
Ask for password when opening bit locked drive for the first time. Now the app crashes

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to 'Files UWP'
2. Click on a drive that is bit locked (first time and it is locked)
3. App crashes

**Expected behavior**
Password should be prompted

**Desktop (please complete the following information):**
 - OS Version: [e.g. Windows 10 2004]
 - App version: [v0.10.1]

review_comments: Are you sure about 6 means drive is protected? Check this [link](https://stackoverflow.com/a/41310139/12258600).

Yes that's the link that helped me implement this. I tested it on my pc on a bitlocker drive and the status is 6 when locked, 1 when unlocked and 2 when not protected. If someone else could test it too I would feel more confident.
